arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
D={'seed':'','definitions':[['r',repr(b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n'+b'Host: h\r\n'+ b'X: '+b'a'*400+b'\r\n')]],'timeout_ms':1,'cases':[],'events':[],'channels':[]}
# 128 headers, ~51KiB request: a source expression so definition stays under8192.
D['definitions']=[['r',"b'GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: h\\r\\n' + (b'X: ' + b'a'*400 + b'\\r\\n')*127 + b'\\r\\n'"]]
D['channels']=[{'name':'x','parts':[{'case':None,'data':'{{ r*20000 }}'}]}]
open('/workspace/tmp/stress.json','w').write(json.dumps(D))
PY
/usr/bin/time -f '%Ucpu %MKB' sh -c 'python3 -B main.py < /workspace/tmp/stress.json > /workspace/tmp/stress.out'
wc -c /workspace/tmp/stress.out
